entries.english:
Judicial proceedings in the case of Count Ludwig Casimir von Hohenlohe-Neuenstein against Sebastian and Hans von Crailsheim and associates concerning hunting rights around Kirchberg.

Contains records concerning hunts conducted by the von Crailsheim family at Crippelberg; two Kirchberg citizens arrested by Crailsheim at Hornberg and subsequently released under an imperial chamber-court mandate; the resulting proceedings, costs, surety, pleadings, evidence, witness examination, and related agreements concerning Hornberg, Märklingen, Sulzberg, and neighboring properties, including an original protest by the von Rosenberg knight-captain against the confiscated hare nets. Also included are the castle peace agreement concerning Hornberg Castle, judgments, surety documents, and cost schedules.

Extent: Qu. 1–94, 6.0 cm
